740420101.text: Incredible! Incredible! How did you hook a fish that quickly... That Linebreaker you defeated looks pretty powerful, too!

740420102.text: Defeated a... a Linebreaker? Paimon doesn't really get what you're saying...

740420103.text: *ahem* The experts at the fishing association say that fishing is like dueling! Fishers use their rods, line, and bait as weapons, and they wrestle against the might of the fish that swim beneath the waves, those great lunkers called Linebreakers! Hence, Linebreaking for short!

740420104.text: Calling it that sounds really strange... It's just fishing, right? There's nothing too special about it.

740420105.text: Unless we're talking about, like... those super massive fish? The ones that can't possibly be landed?

740420106.text: No, no! Sorry for making you feel so confused. It must be a problem with the way I explained it. Yes, the problem lies with me!

740420107.text: Even though I am the director of the Fontaine Fishing Association, I've never managed to catch even a single fish... So when I watched you hook one without any difficulty at all, I was especially shocked!

740420108.text: Director? That sounds like a pretty important position!

740420109.text: But you said you've never caught a fish before. Then how did you manage to become the director?

740420110.text: Oh, that has nothing to do with fishing itself. It's just that everyone holds the equipment I provide in high regard.

740420111.text: I used to be an ordinary clerk at the Fontaine Research Institute. I was in charge of purchasing equipment and negotiating prices with vendors... But most of the time, I was just waiting for responses from them.

740420112.text: All I could do was wander around the streets in search of something to do while waiting for them to get back to me. It felt like I was wasting my life, and I just couldn't take it anymore!

740420113.text: Wasting your life... and you couldn't take it? You don't have to do anything, and people will still think you're hard at work! Why would you be upset about that? Paimon doesn't get it...

740420116.text: Thankfully, I met my new friends at the Fishing Association and they introduced me to the fun of fishing! After getting hooked on this hobby, my life took on a whole new direction!

740420117.text: To repay them, I provided them with lots of equipment sitting around unused by the Institute. Using the kits I gave them, the members of the association started getting quite a few more bites on their hooks!

740420118.text: They credited me for all their newfound success. Since I was familiar with the process of interacting with vendors and had an excess of free time, everyone elected me as director...

740420119.text: But even though I'm now partially in charge of the Fishing Association, I've still never caught any fish... Not even a fry as big as my finger. I can't help but feel like I'm not doing my job!

740420120.text: Maybe... you were just super unlucky? Maybe the fish are like you, wandering off for a swim instead of doing their jobs and sticking around near the hook?

740420121.text: But we caught some fish just now, which means the fishes are back at their posts and doing their jobs! Why don't you give it another shot right now?

740420122.text: That... sounds like a good idea! I'll give it another shot!

740420124.text: Paimon thinks that Delaroche is pretty honest! She even told us stuff like how she's skipping out on work and fishing on the job without any hesitation.

740420125.text: But, now that Paimon thinks about it, is it really possible for someone to fish for months and never get a bite? Just what's going on here?

740420126.text: If Delaroche doesn't manage to catch a fish and loses her confidence, or if people start doubting her and she gets replaced as the director of the Fishing Association, maybe the new person won't be nearly as easy to get along with...

740421702.text: Ah! This piece of kit, well, if you really want to talk about it, there's a ton of details. I already went over some of the advantages with you just now.

740421703.text: As for its disadvantages... It's too expensive and too time-consuming to make. The inside is full of these... intricate mechanisms. I heard it's comparable to a watch!

740421704.text: On my current salary, I can't afford to purchase more than a few pieces of bait like this, so my next goal will be to reduce its costs...

740421705.text: Of course, I'll need to rely on my friends at the institute for this. I... I can stand by their side, cheering them on!

740421201.text: Hmm? Delaroche's hook doesn't have any bait on it at all... Even a layman knows that fishing requires bait. How can you catch a fish with just an empty hook?

740421202.text: If we ask Delaroche directly, it might seem like we're insulting her intelligence...

740421203.text: It might be a bit too rude!

740421206.text: Good idea! Let's try to be more tactful this time. Let's think of it as practice for dealing with any well-intentioned but very confused people we might run into in the future!

740421207.text: But we already dove down here to check her hook, leaving it completely bare like this is kind of a shame... Maybe there's something more we can do?

740420301.text: Did you catch a fish? Congratulations!

740420302.text: Ah! I thought you two left. Thankfully, you didn't miss out on this momentous moment! I have incredibly wonderful news for you!

740420303.text: Just now, I finally... finally! Finally caught a huge fish! This fish's physique and weight are beyond compare. My friends at the association will be agog when they see it!

740420304.text: And it's all thanks to your advice. As of today, I have finally ceased to be fishless... I must sincerely express my deepest gratitude to you both!

740420305.text: Uh... congratulations! We just wanna ask, why don't you usually use bait... Uh, Paimon means, what is your favorite kind of bait to use?

740420306.text: Hm? Why are you suddenly asking about that? I'm not that proficient with bait types, really...

740420307.text: I only heard an older angler say: "The more the bait diffuses, the more fish it can attract." So, I supplemented the most popular bait formulas with a substance that dissolves more easily in the water...

740420308.text: Hold on, does this mean that overly soft bait will lose out to Linebreakers in battle... Is that why I never managed to catch any fish before?

740420311.text: Oh! So it's not that she didn't use bait, but the bait she used completely disintegrated? If it just turned into soup in the water... then why would the fish ever bite the hook!?

740420312.text: I think I understand... I finally understand! You two have granted me the essential epiphany! Please... accept my sincerest thanks!

740420313.text: Of course, this meager reward isn't enough. Once I become a master angler renowned throughout Fontaine, you will be known as my distinguished mentors. Such a title will be priceless!

740420314.text: Next, I'm going to alter the composition of my bait. I'll make it sturdier, and then I'll beat the strongest of the Linebreakers with but a few tugs!

740420315.text: That's not exactly how it's supposed to work, but at least Delaroche knows not to use bait that easily dissolves! Things turned out okay, right?

740420316.text: Paimon hopes everything will go as smoothly as Delaroche imagines!

740420501.text: What kind of bait should be placed on the hook?

740420401.text: Have you had much luck recently?

740420402.text: Whoa! You two finally showed up again!

740420403.text: I hope your arrival heralds the revival of my fishing career once again...

740420404.text: No, no! I must execute the plan and use my own strength to overcome any problems. I can't just rely on other people to do the thinking all the time!

740420405.text: What? What's wrong? Why are you panicking?

740420409.text: Ever since you two inspired me, I've completely changed how I think about making bait. I increased the strength, and now it can't possibly be destroyed when I'm scuffling against a Linebreaker!

740420410.text: But even so, I still can't catch a single fish, much less relive the glory I felt that day...

740420411.text: #Uh, d—don't worry! The fish you caught then was... a rare specimen! You can't catch another one like that twice in a short time... right, {NICKNAME}?

740420701.text: Have you tried any new bait recently?

740420702.text: Hahaha! My "Gods of Victorious Linebreaking"! You're right on time! Soon, you shall witness the moment when I surpass myself and make history!

740420703.text: Huh? Delaroche sure is confident today... Seems like fishing has been going well for her!

740420704.text: That's right! I wish to speak with you about a miracle I experienced. As I was testing my bait before, I found a new type of bait of unknown provenance, and I know not which expert bait-maker created it...

740420705.text: Upon being cast into the water, it can immediately attract all the nearby fish! I heard it uses advanced alchemy, so even if you know the formula, an ordinary person can't replicate the effects!

740420706.text: I'm guessing it's you two that blessed me with the luck to meet such a master bait-maker! This superb, preeminent, and all-supreme master is unmatched and unequalled in their generosity leaving me such bait!

740420707.text: Yeah! This superb, preeminent... uh, all-supreme master sounds really nice!

740420710.text: At this point, I cannot let the efforts of this benefactor go to waste! They must have left the bait to inspire me, not to give me a completed product for me to copy and rely on.

740420711.text: I'll only be able to catch a few paltry fish if the bait only lasts for a moment or two, but by understanding the principles underlying the effectiveness of the bait, I will be able to hook countless monster-sized fish!

740420712.text: So, I strained my brain to the fullest and bought a few special gifts before inviting a few researcher friends of mine over to help create the "Active Odor Imitating Bait"...

740420713.text: This device can analyze the odors given off by dissolving bait and will use other ingredients to imitate the effects! Using this, I can become the greatest angler in all of Fontaine!

740420714.text: Wait, you need to slow down a bit! Going from someone who just made a new kind of bait to being the greatest fisher in Fontaine... You seemed to have skipped over a bunch of steps in between!

740420715.text: The details are unimportant! After receiving your encouragement, my motivation has ascended far beyond what was once possible. If I can't rise to the top in one go, that would be simply unacceptable!

740420602.text: You two! You two are my "Gods of Victorious Linebreaking"!

740420603.text: Every time you show up, it's like I'm imbued with some kind of power, and just reel these Linebreakers right up!

740420604.text: Hm! We were just mentors last time, and now, we're gods... This is getting ridiculous!

740420607.text: Aaaah! I almost forgot. I am so sorry! I'll go to the bank later and see how much savings I have...

740420609.text: #Agh! No, wait! {NICKNAME} is probably just joking!

740420610.text: Asking for money while claiming to be a god is what scammers do!

740420611.text: This time... Uh... Well, from now on, every time you catch a fish, you must believe that you can defeat even the strongest of Linebreakers with just your... uh, what's it called?

740420612.text: Right! With your determination and dedication to fishing!

740420613.text: Of course, it's also important to choose the right bait... Maybe there are different types of bait that are even more effective than the ones you've been using, and might help you hook even bigger fishes. You should try using more types of bait!

740420616.text: If you want to thank us, you don't need to clean out your savings. You just need to reasonably express your gratitude.

740420617.text: You two! You're positively glowing right now!

740420618.text: I've never been so encouraged by someone else before!

740420619.text: But please don't be so modest with me! What's a bit of Mora compared to all the inspiration you gave me? It is but the paltriest expression of my gratitude!

740420620.text: I will remember your teachings, and my efforts will be unceasing! Henceforth, I shall not waste a single second more!

740420621.text: As for the bait, I thank you both for your reminders! I will keep trying new combinations! And soon, you will see... a confident and mighty expert angler!

740420622.text: Delaroche goes back to fishing with renewed focus...

740420623.text: Delaroche still ended up giving us some Mora... It's not a lot, but she sure is sincere!

740420624.text: How about we just put some normal bait in her luggage? When she starts experimenting with bait later, she'll find that ours is the most effective and stop using the wrong stuff!

740420625.text: You place effective yet easy-to-make bait into Delaroche's luggage...

740420626.text: Perfect! This way, Delaroche will always be able to hook the biggest of fish in the future!

740420627.text: And our labors will finally come to an end!

740420902.text: How did it go? Did you find my "Active Odor Imitating Bait"?

740420903.text: It's right here, Delaroche, hold onto it! But don't get too excited just yet. There's something very important we have to tell you...

740420904.text: #(Agh. {NICKNAME}, do we want to speak to her slowly and rationally or... exaggerate a little? Y'know, scare her and emphasize how dangerous this piece of bait is?)

740421002.text: (Alright! Then let's emphasize how, uh... most of the fish will be scared off if monsters appear! Not being able to catch any fish should unnerve Delaroche enough to stop using that dangerous bait!)

740421003.text: You and Paimon describe the incident that just happened underwater to Delaroche, stressing how the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" will attract aquatic monsters and threaten the fishing spot...\nThough you don't know much about the ecological relations between aquatic monsters and regular fish, you've met your share of scholars, and find yourself more than capable of imitating their manner of speaking...

740421004.text: You artfully describe how some aquatic monsters will completely clear all fish from an area just by passing through those waters, as they are known to frequently emit an "indescribable screech." Even fish not regularly predated by the monsters will be unable to endure such a disturbance, and will thus scatter in terror...

740421005.text: Your descriptions are so vivid, they render Delaroche dumbstruck. Facing the waters with a grave expression, she spends a long moment in silent rumination before shifting her attention back to the present...

740421006.text: So that means that the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" can disturb an entire section of the underwater ecology. I never thought it could have such an enormous impact...

740421007.text: Thank you for your advice! I absolutely shouldn't use the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" so crudely and irresponsibly, or risk damaging underwater habitats...

740421008.text: I should treat it as a tool, and study the bait I found last time! Using the imitated scents as a starting point, I should be able to better analyze the composition of bait like that...

740421009.text: Now that I think about it, perhaps I can use this method to learn about making bait. If I understand the principles behind bait-making, I'll be able to improve by leaps and bounds!

740421010.text: Haha! When the time comes, I'll even be able to help the others in the Fishing Association make superior bait, and help everyone catch some whopping big fish!

740421102.text: (Hmm. That could work too. Delaroche doesn't seem to realize just how dangerous some things are, after all... Maybe if we don't make things sound super scary, she won't take these matters seriously, and will just end up hurting herself!)

740421103.text: You and Paimon describe the incident that just happened underwater to Delaroche, stressing how dangerous the monsters drawn by the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" are...\nTo better illustrate to Delaroche how helpless an ordinary person would be when faced with an aquatic monster, you and Paimon begin a lively performance to aid her conceptualization...

740421104.text: You play a large monster while Paimon plays a smaller one. You begin a game of catch using a Sunsettia, tossing it back and forth as it becomes more and more mangled. Said Sunsettia symbolizes an ordinary person.\nThus, it dawns on Delaroche: "Though the difference in size may not be so great, this is what happens when an ordinary person encounters an aquatic monster. A human will be completely helpless, and become a mere plaything!"

740421105.text: After the demonstration, Paimon promptly eats the Sunsettia...

740421106.text: Nom... Nom... Anyway! People who get nabbed by aquatic monsters be helpless, just like that! Even if they don't get eaten, they're going to be pretty miserable!

740421107.text: I never thought the effects of the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" would be so extreme. I didn't think it would attract anything that couldn't be caught and eaten...

740421108.text: Your feedback has been crucial! I'll keep the maximum efficacy of the "Active Odor Imitating Bait" low and maintain it at a level that can attract Linebreakers, but nothing out of the ordinary...

740421109.text: In terms of safety precautions, I'll also need to prepare a weapon I'm familiar with and prepare to... repel any aquatic monsters that leap above the surface, and perhaps even cut the line if things are untenable!

740421110.text: That's good! Delaroche finally knows how serious things are and her enthusiasm hasn't been curbed... We can relax now!

740421111.text: *sigh* Scrambling around like that is so tiring, especially since Paimon was nervous the whole time...

740421301.text: Don't worry. Your tide will come in...

740421302.text: Alright! I can stay calm! Thanks for your encouragement!

740421303.text: All that time... I held on despite never catching a single fish. What's a few more hours compared to that?

740421401.text: Keep going! Take down that Linebreaker!

740421402.text: Okay! I won't let you down!

740421403.text: Thanks to your reminders last time, I managed to find the heart of the problem! Now, I urgently need to create much sturdier bait!

740421404.text: I'll need to find more references and prepare enough high-quality ingredients...

740421601.text: Remember to try many more different types of bait!

740421602.text: Of course! I could never ignore any advice bestowed upon me by the "Gods of Victorious Linebreaking"!

740421603.text: After finding effective bait, I must also research its key ingredients and understand the underlying principles behind it...

740421604.text: Yes. I must keep trying, keep striving!

740420201.text: What kind of fish should be put on the hook?

740421501.text: Regarding the strength of the bait...

740421502.text: That's a good question! Before, I noticed that most bait includes flour, but no matter how I adjusted the formula, it just wasn't hard enough.

740421503.text: So this time, I added mineral powder to the mix along with construction materials for building walls.

740421504.text: Let's see those Linebreakers try to shatter stone, haha!

740429902.text: #Eek! Monsters! Could it be that the bait drew them to this area... Get rid of them quick, {NICKNAME}!
